About Brainrot Mega Parkour

Step into the wildest parkour adventure yet. Brainrot Mega Parkour brings together four intense modes, forty handcrafted levels, and a cast of hilarious characters in a single high-speed package. Whether you’re climbing an endless tower, racing across a platform full of traps, escaping a rolling lava ball, or surviving a lava flood, every level pushes your reflexes and timing to the limit.
